expectations.text: Asks whether this is a one-off fix after a bad support quarter or a compounding surface Freightwise will run for years, and ties that answer to which rung it recommends
expectations.evidence: The transcript never asks whether this is a one-off fix or a long-lived surface. The closest point is Q6, which asks about 'the effort ceiling beyond the 6 weeks' and who will answer alerts and tune thresholds. That touches ongoing ownership but does not frame the one-off versus compounding question. The rung choice (the delivery-attempt log) rests on the skill's default and the 6-week window, and it is never conditioned on this answer. Q1 and Q4 change the plan based on who the partners are and how fast failures cost money, not on how long Freightwise will run the surface.
